extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH grant biosketches and Other Support/Current and Pending Support documentation
extracted.subtask_short: preparing NIH biosketch and other support
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for completing NIH-format Biographical Sketches (biosketches) and Other Support/Current and Pending Support sections for grant applications, including required fields, formatting, and what to include/exclude. Targets senior/key personnel and significant contributors listed on applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch overall format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The entire biosketch for each individual must follow the specified format and must not exceed five pages. Use the provided section headings (A–D) and include only the requested information in the prescribed order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification header fields
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME; eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login); POSITION TITLE
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's full name, their eRA Commons user name (or equivalent credential/login), and the official position title at the top of the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training section content and format
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.) INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE (if applicable); Completion Date MM/YYYY; FIELD OF STUDY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List training entries starting from the earliest (baccalaureate) through postdoctoral/residency. Provide institution and location, degree (if applicable), completion date in MM/YYYY format, and field of study. Add or delete rows to reflect actual training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section A — Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise statement summarizing the individual's qualifications, relevant experience, and role on the proposed project. Describe how the individual's background and resources will contribute to the project's success (examples in the text show describing leadership roles, core responsibilities, and how the individual will support the PI).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section B — Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors; Positions and Employment; Other Experience and Professional Memberships; Honors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions and employment chronologically (with dates), other relevant experience and professional memberships, and honors/awards. Include dates and brief descriptors as shown in examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section C — Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide narrative descriptions of up to several major contributions to science (numbered), with context explaining significance and impact. For each contribution include representative citations (a., b., c., etc.) to published work that illustrates the contribution. The narrative should explain the contribution's importance and how it advances the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section D — Research Support (Current and Completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support; Current Research Support; Completed Research Support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List active and completed research support with project number/dates, project title, funding source/agency, role (e.g., PI, Co-I, subsite PI), project period (dates), and a brief 'Goal' or project description. Distinguish current/ongoing from completed support. Use concise entries as illustrated in the document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete List of Published Work (MyBibliography)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography: [URL]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a link or pointer to the individual's complete published works (e.g., MyNCBI/MyBibliography) with ordering/sorting as desired (the example shows sorting by date, descending).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Support / PHS 398 OTHER SUPPORT: what to include
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide active and pending support for all senior/key personnel. Other Support includes all financial resources, whether Federal, non-Federal, commercial or institutional, available in direct support of an individual's research endeavors, including but not limited to research grants, cooperative agreements, contracts, and/or institutional awards. Training awards, prizes, or gifts do not need to be included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include all sources of financial support that contribute to the individual's research activities (federal, non-federal, commercial, institutional). Exclude training awards, prizes, and gifts. Provide separate entries for active and pending support. Use the sample format shown and continuation pages if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Support — format and continuation pages
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no 'form page' for other support. Information on other support should be provided in the format shown below, using continuation pages as necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare Other Support information in a narrative/entry format (not on a predefined form). If the information does not fit on a single page, use continuation pages. Follow the sample entry layout demonstrated in the document (project title, PI, dates, effort, funding source, role, goal).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effort reporting for Other Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Effort devoted to projects must be measured using person months. Indicate calendar, academic, and/or summer months associated with each project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each listed project/state the amount of effort in person-months and specify whether those months are calendar, academic, or summer. The examples show numeric calendar-month commitments (e.g., '0.6 calendar'). This is required to assess overlap/conflicts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not submit Other Support unless requested (PHS 398 New and Renewal Applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: For New and Renewal Applications (PHS 398) – DO NOT SUBMIT UNLESS REQUESTED PHS 398 OTHER SUPPORT
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow agency-specific instructions: for PHS 398 new and renewal applications, do not include the Other Support documentation unless specifically requested by the agency or solicitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide active and pending support for all senior/key personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide active and pending support for all senior/key personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure that every senior/key person named on the application has their active and pending support listed in the Other Support/Current and Pending Support documentation, using the required format and including effort information.
